subject: Sample kit shipment: weight discrepancy and damaged pallet (ASN 83127)

From: BrightLine Apparel <orders@brightlineapparel.com>

Subject: ASN 83127 — partial short + pallet crush on shipment to ExpoWest Booth 5B

Alex / Redwood team,

Quick heads up — our warehouse completed the outbound for your sample-kits order (ASN 83127) this morning and the carrier reported a weight variance at pick-up. The manifest shows 420 kits but our scale recorded shipment weight consistent with ~380 kits. In addition, carrier photos show one outer pallet with edge crush (attached). We’ve pulled the docs and attached the ASN and photos.

Immediate next steps we recommend:
- Carrier to confirm BOL and pallet weights (we’ve asked NorthStar to confirm).
- BrightLine can inspect remaining inventory and fast-produce up to 200 replacement kits (lead time ~4 business days) — quote attached if you want to proceed.

Sorry for the scramble. We’ll keep you updated — tell us whether you want BrightLine to print replacements or file a carrier claim and wait on salvage.

Thanks,
Julia Park
Operations Lead
BrightLine Apparel
Attachments: ASN_83127.pdf, photo_pallet_damage.jpg, reprint_quote_BrightLine_200kits.pdf
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Julia Park <orders@brightlineapparel.com>, NorthStar Freight <alex@northstarfwd.com>

Date: Fri, 3 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ASN 83127 — partial short + pallet crush on shipment to ExpoWest Booth 5B

Julia / Alex (NorthStar),

Thanks — appreciate the quick flag. Important context for ExpoWest: these 420 kits were scheduled to arrive at Booth 5B on Monday morning for setup. Lauren, Marcus — can you confirm minimum acceptable kit count to operate the activation?

Options I want to evaluate in parallel:
1) Authorize BrightLine reprint of 200 kits and route via expedited freight (we absorb cost or bill to the event line item)
2) File a carrier damage/shortage claim and attempt salvage — may miss Monday setup

NorthStar: please share carrier BOL and weight confirmation (attach BOL). We need ETA update for the remaining pallets and whether the damaged pallet can be consolidated for local recovery.

If BrightLine can turn 200 replacements in 4 business days, that would land Wed/Thu — still risky for Monday. If you have a faster reprint or local kitting option, flag it.

Alex Martinez
Events Program Manager | Redwood Inference

Alex — attaching the carrier paperwork and our photo log. Confirmed: pick-up counted 4 pallets, BOL weight 1,185 kg which corresponds to ~380 kits based on BrightLine unit weight. One pallet shows edge damage and several loose boxes. ETA to ExpoWest dock remains Mon 08:00 local, but the manifest scan shows two pallets delayed with the outbound truck — estimated arrival Mon 14:30.

If you need replacements delivered to booth before the 14:30 pallet arrival, we can arrange a local same-day courier pickup from BrightLine (if they can print) and deliver by afternoon for an expedite fee.

Attached: NorthStar_BOL_78921.pdf

— Alex, Operations, NorthStar Freight
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: ASN 83127 — minimum kit needs and contingency

Team — quick answers:
- Minimum to run activation at 70% feature is 300 kits (we can stagger demos and use digital lighter items).
- If we land 380 kits by Mon 14:30, operations can re-prioritize setup to have essentials first and rest of kits during day.
- If worst-case (only 300 arrive), we need 20 replacement VIP kits day-of and 100 general kits within 48 hours.

Recommendation: APPROVE BrightLine reprint for 200 kits and request expedited courier for 100 of those to arrive Mon afternoon if possible. Remaining 100 can be economy ship to hotel storage. Marcus — please confirm budget approval for expedite (charge to event code EVNT-2026-09). Stephanie — track claims and credits.

Lauren Bishop
Senior Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference

Stephanie — open a carrier claim for the damaged pallet and request credit; include photos in the claim. Lauren — I’ll allocate $1,250 for same-day courier if BrightLine can deliver 100 kits Mon afternoon.
